provenance.lateral: estimate; effective lateral grip envelope fit to own parkland flying laps (not a platform constant)
provenance.brake: estimate; effective braking envelope fit to own parkland flying laps
provenance.accel: estimate; effective acceleration envelope fit to own parkland flying laps
provenance.speed_cap: estimate; effective top-speed envelope fit to own parkland flying laps
provenance.energy_mj_per_s: MEASURED from own public_events energy_mode (q0.8 of 527 drain samples)
provenance.safety_margin_m: chosen geometric margin 0.5 m (road half-widths 6-8 m); not a platform penalty threshold

calibration.method: grid fit of effective dynamics to own best dry qualifying lap; private training.jsonl unavailable (game-competitions-only)
calibration.note: All recent own matches are parkland (frozen seed). highland/crossover outputs are extrapolations.
